limits: Qualified for this local POSIX/macOS test lane, not a production storage promise.
fsync issued; no F_FULLFSYNC/device power-loss guarantee or power-cut testing.
Crash-stale lock or pending file requires deliberate manual recovery; no silent replay/cleanup of uncertain commits.
Unkeyed checksums are not authentication and cannot detect complete trailing rollback/deletion without an external trusted head.
Trusted root and parent topology; no claim of descriptor-relative protection against malicious concurrent host filesystem changes.
Synchronous storage methods block the event loop and use scan-on-operation; not a large-scale store.
